name: Burn the greydwarfs
description: Greydwarfs, their brutes and shamans are very weak to fire. Fire arrows (8 wood, 2 resin, 2 feathers make 20) or a torch make short work of them.
veteranNotes: All three greydwarf types list fire as veryWeak and poison as resistant, and are immune to spirit.

name: Smash skeletons
description: Skeletons are weak to blunt and fire damage but resist pierce, so a club or mace beats arrows in the crypts. Poison does nothing to them.
veteranNotes: Skeleton, rancid remains and the regional skeletons (Swamp, Mountain, Deep North) share: blunt weak, fire weak, pierce resistant, frost resistant, poison immune.

name: Use pierce on trolls
description: Trolls are weak to pierce and resist blunt. Keep your distance and use arrows or a spear; their swings hit for 60 to 70 blunt.
veteranNotes: A troll has 600 health and drops 5 troll hide. Its thrown rock deals 50 blunt.

name: Fine wood needs a better axe
description: Birch and oak trees give fine wood, but they need an axe of tool tier 2. The flint axe (tier 1) cannot cut them; a bronze axe (tier 2) can.
veteranNotes: Tool tiers from the data: stone axe 0, flint axe 1, bronze axe 2, iron axe 3, black metal axe 4.

name: Surtling cores in burial chambers
description: Burial chambers in the Black Forest contain surtling core stands. A smelter and a charcoal kiln each need 5 surtling cores and 20 stone, so crypts let you smelt before you ever visit the Swamp.
veteranNotes: Forest crypt rooms also hold treasure chests, bone pile spawners and, in some rooms, a Vegvisir to The Elder (40% per room).

name: Ores cannot use portals
description: A portal costs 10 greydwarf eyes, 20 fine wood and 2 surtling cores. Ores and scrap metal cannot be teleported, so plan a boat or cart route for them.
veteranNotes: Items flagged not teleportable in the data include copper ore, tin ore, iron scrap, silver ore, black metal scrap, flametal ore, petrified tissue and dragon eggs.

name: Jerky lasts longer
description: Boar jerky gives 23 health and 23 stamina for 1800 s, longer than cooked boar meat (30 health, 10 stamina, 1200 s). Make 2 at the cauldron from 1 raw boar meat and 1 honey.
veteranNotes: Wolf jerky (Mountains) follows the same idea: 33 health, 33 stamina, 1800 s.

name: Get rested
description: The Rested buff, earned by resting in a sheltered spot, gives faster health and stamina regeneration and 50% more skill experience. Rest before you head out.
veteranNotes: Rested: health regen x1.5, stamina and eitr regen x2, experience x1.5, base duration 480 s. Shelter adds 2 comfort.

name: The Swamp keeps you wet
description: Swamp rain is the only weather in the Swamp. Being Wet slows your health regeneration and makes you weak to frost and lightning, though it also gives fire resistance.
veteranNotes: Wet lasts 120 s after leaving the rain: health regen x0.75, stamina and eitr regen x0.85.

name: Crush the blobs
description: Blobs and oozers are weak to blunt, frost and lightning but resist slash, pierce and fire. Their poison hits for 90 and 115, so fight them from full health.
veteranNotes: Blobs drop ooze (1-2), oozers drop 2-3. Both are immune to poison.

name: Poison resistance mead
description: Poison resistance mead makes you very resistant to poison. The base needs 10 honey, 5 thistle, 10 coal and 1 neck tail; one base ferments into 6 meads.
veteranNotes: Cooldown is 600 s. Base is made at the mead ketill; the fermenter takes 3600 s per batch.

name: Surtlings at geysers
description: Fire geysers in the Swamp spawn surtlings. Each surtling has a 50% chance to drop a surtling core and always drops coal. They are immune to fire and weak to frost.
veteranNotes: A geyser location lists up to 3 surtlings; the spawner comment says one respawns every 5 minutes.

name: Abominations hate fire
description: Abominations resist blunt, are very resistant to pierce and immune to frost, but fire damage works well. Their slam hits for 80 blunt.
veteranNotes: An abomination has 800 health and drops 5 root and 3-5 guck.

name: Wraiths and spirit damage
description: Wraiths resist blunt, slash and pierce and are immune to frost and poison. Fire and spirit damage are their weak spots.
veteranNotes: Wraiths have 100 health, hit for 60 slash and always drop a chain.

name: Fighting Bonemass
description: Bonemass is weak to blunt and frost, very resistant to pierce and fire, and immune to poison. Bring a mace and poison resistance: his poison attack deals 130.
veteranNotes: Summon with 10 withered bones. He has 5000 health and drops the Wishbone and his trophy.

name: Stay warm in the Mountains
description: Mountain snow brings the Freezing status: it drains health and cuts stamina regeneration. Frost resistance mead, the wolf armor chest, wolf fur cape, lox cape and fenris coat all give frost resistance.
veteranNotes: Both Mountain weathers (Snow, Snow storm) carry the freeze flag. Freezing sets stamina and eitr regen to x0.4 and health regen to 0.

name: Silver needs iron
description: Silver veins and obsidian need a pickaxe of tool tier 2. The bronze pickaxe (tier 1) will not work; the iron pickaxe (tier 2) will.
veteranNotes: Pickaxe tool tiers: antler 0, bronze 1, iron 2, black metal 3.

name: Mine the stone golem
description: Stone golems are very weak to pickaxe damage and resist slash and pierce. Hitting one with your pickaxe is surprisingly effective.
veteranNotes: They have 800 health, hit for 110 blunt, are immune to fire, frost, poison and spirit, and drop 8-12 crystals.

name: Drakes and fire
description: Drakes are weak to fire and immune to frost. Their ice shards deal 90 frost, so shoot them down with fire arrows before they close in.
veteranNotes: Drakes have 100 health and drop 1-2 freeze glands, used for frost arrows and Frostner.

name: Dragon eggs are heavy
description: Dragon eggs weigh 200 each and cannot go through portals. Moder's altar needs 3, so plan a base or path near her altar.
veteranNotes: Stack size is 1 and the egg floats in water.

name: Fighting Moder
description: Moder is weak to fire and immune to frost. Her breath and ice shards deal 200 frost, so frost resistance is essential.
veteranNotes: She has 7500 health, is summoned with 3 dragon eggs and drops 10 dragon tears.

name: Deal with deathsquitos
description: Deathsquitos have only 10 health but bite for 90 pierce. A single hit kills one, and the anti-sting concoction makes them flee for 600 s.
veteranNotes: The anti-sting base needs 10 cloudberries, 3 grouper and 1 fragrant bundle; the fermenter makes 6.

name: Leave the lox alone early
description: Lox have 1000 health and a stomp of 120 blunt. They resist blunt and slash but are weak to fire. Fight them only when you are ready.
veteranNotes: Lox drop 4-6 lox meat and 2-3 lox pelts; cooked lox meat gives 50 health and 16 stamina for 1200 s.

name: Fire resistance barley wine
description: Fire resistance barley wine makes you resistant to fire. The base is 10 barley and 10 cloudberries; one base ferments into 6 bottles.
veteranNotes: Cooldown 600 s. Several Ashlands foes deal fire damage (lava blob explosions, fallen valkyrie spit).

name: Fighting Yagluth
description: Yagluth is very resistant to pierce, resistant to fire and immune to poison. His meteors, breath and nova combine fire and lightning damage.
veteranNotes: He has 10000 health, is summoned with 5 fuling totems and drops 3 torn spirits.

name: Clear the mist
description: The Wisplight pushes back the Mistlands fog. Craft it at the workbench from 1 silver and 1 wisp; wisps come from a wisp fountain (10 stone + 1 torn spirit from Yagluth).
veteranNotes: The wisp fountain is built at the stonecutter. The Wisplight's light has a 10 m range in the data.

name: Opening the citadel
description: The Queen's infested citadel needs a sealbreaker: 9 sealbreaker fragments combined at the galdr table. Fragments come from crystal altars inside infested mines.
veteranNotes: Infested mine rooms can also hold a Vegvisir to the Queen (20% in some rooms), black cores and royal jelly.

name: Black metal tools for the Mistlands
description: Giant skeleton parts need a tier 3 pickaxe (black metal) and yggdrasil shoots need a tier 4 axe (black metal axe). Bring both before heading into the mist.
veteranNotes: Giant ribs and skulls give black marble, the brain gives soft tissue, and the sword and helmet pieces give copper and iron scrap.

name: Charred are weak to spirit
description: Charred warriors, marksmen, twitchers and warlocks are weak to spirit damage, very resistant to fire and resistant to pierce. Leave the fire weapons at home.
veteranNotes: A charred warrior has 600 health and a thrust of 160 pierce; marksmen shoot for 120 pierce.

name: Morgens and lightning
description: Morgens resist blunt, slash, pierce and fire but are weak to lightning. You find them in putrid holes, and they bite for 160 pierce.
veteranNotes: A morgen has 1600 health and drops morgen sinew and morgen heart (50% each).

name: Kill lava blobs at range
description: Lava blobs explode for heavy blunt and fire damage. They are weak to blunt, frost and lightning and immune to fire; kill them from a distance.
veteranNotes: Explosion: 70 blunt, 30 fire, plus 160 chop and pickaxe damage to structures and terrain. 300 health.

name: Bloodgold needs a strong tool
description: Gammeltroll remains, the source of petrified tissue for bloodgold, need tool tier 6. Weapons such as the flametal mace or the berserkir axes have that tier.
veteranNotes: The tier 3 black metal pickaxe is not enough; tool tier 6 items in the data include the flametal mace, berserkir axes, Dyrnwyn and the nord sword.

name: Hexen cast lightning
description: Hexen blast you with up to 120 lightning, while krigen charge for 160 blunt and are very resistant to frost. Hexen have a 10% chance to drop an intricate key.
veteranNotes: Hexen have 850 health, krigen 1200. Krigen can drop memorial coal (20%) and leather straps.

name: Carry more with Megingjord
description: Haldor the trader sells Megingjord for 950 coins; it adds 150 carry weight. Mead of troll endurance adds 250 carry weight for 300 s.
veteranNotes: Haldor also sells the fishing rod (350) and fishing bait; some stock unlocks after bosses are defeated.
